dimensions.assessment: Affects infants, high-risk infants, families utilizing WIC, nonprofit donor human milk banks, and healthcare clinicians such as pediatricians and lactation consultants.
dimensions.evidence: distribute educational materials to-- clinicians... expectant and new parents, with a focus on expectant and new parents that are participating in the special supplemental nutrition program for women, infants, and children

dimensions.assessment: Expands WIC allowable uses for milk collection, provides emergency grant funding for milk banks, and mandates federal safety standards and guidance.
dimensions.evidence: A State agency may use amounts made available under clause (i) for-- collecting and storing donations of unprocessed human milk; and the transfer of the milk... to a nonprofit donor human milk bank

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations of $3,000,000 for fiscal year 2026 and such sums as necessary thereafter for emergency capacity grants, alongside permissive use of existing WIC funds.
dimensions.evidence: there are authorized to be appropriated $3,000,000 for fiscal year 2026, and such sums as may be necessary for each fiscal year thereafter.

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Child Nutrition Act of 1966, establishes new grant programs under the Department of Health and Human Services, and requires FDA safety guidance.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of Health and Human Services... shall award competitive grants... to eligible entities for expanding emergency capacity with respect to banking donor human milk.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent regulatory guidance requirements and ongoing grant authorizations beginning in fiscal year 2026.
dimensions.evidence: there are authorized to be appropriated $3,000,000 for fiscal year 2026, and such sums as may be necessary for each fiscal year thereafter.

importance_detail.rationale: The Access to Donor Milk Act of 2026 supports donor human milk activities within WIC programs, authorizes competitive emergency capacity grants of $3,000,000 for fiscal year 2026 with ongoing authorizations, establishes public awareness campaigns, and directs the FDA to issue safety standards and guidance.
